# OpenIE Avalanche — Educational Reference (https://avalanche.openie.dev)

> An open educational guide to evolutionary and computational ratchets, the 9-Rung Computer Intelligence Avalanche (explicitly scoped as an interpretive architectural taxonomy `[M]`, strictly separated from machine-checked `Lean 4.36.0` theorems `[T]` and physical DC shunt telemetry `[E]`), Proposition 1's Compilation Threshold, the atomic 64-codon `LUT6` (`u64`) basis, thermodynamic forcing functions, and falsifiable scientific forecasting. **Signed Provenance · Self-Checked** (`measured_j ⊥ reported_j ⊥ est_j ⊥ unmetered`, `0` external peer reviews yet).

## Core Scientific & Educational Concepts

- **What a Ratchet Is (`C = T ∘ G_θ ∘ E`)**: Across `3.8` billion years of biology (`CL01–CL24`) and `76` years of AI history (`AI01–AI38`), collective capability scales when participants **Externalize** structured state (`E`), **Ingest** strictly across cooperative activation thresholds and verification gates (`G_θ`, `V_j = 1`), and **Transform** state into non-regressing shared memory (`T`, `Q(t+1) >= Q(t)`).
- **Coherence per Joule (`CpJ`)**: `CpJ = Q / (E_compute + E_comm + E_idle)` [verified coherence units / J]. Energy in joules is the sole continuous variable, and measurement belongs in the harness (`measured_j` physical shunts strictly separated from `reported_j` on-chip counters and `est_j` RTL switching models).
- **The 9-Rung Computer Intelligence Avalanche**:
  - *Phase 1 — Stateless Ephemeral Inference (`ΔT ≈ 1 <= ΔT*`)*: `R1 Search`, `R2 Generation`, `R3 Reasoning`, `R4 Communication`, `R5 Tool Use`.
  - *The Compilation Threshold (Proposition 1)*: `ΔT > ΔT* = E_compile / (p_0'(c_wake - c_0))` paired with a sound verification gate `C(z) = 1` (`CTA-T3..T6`, `CTA-T41..T45`).
  - *Phase 2 — Stateful Compiled Substrates (`ΔT > ΔT*`)*: `R6 Immersion`, `R7 Competence`, `R8 Ecology`, `R9 Economy`.
- **The Atomic 64-Codon `LUT6` (`u64`) Basis & `16 KB` `#![no_std]` Bootstrap Nucleus**:
  - *64-Codon ↔ `LUT6` Isomorphism*: Biology (`4^3 = 64` codons) and digital logic (`2^6 = 64` truth-table bits in one `u64` `INIT` mask) converge on a discrete, local, functionally complete basis supporting zero-interference overlay patches (no catastrophic forgetting), `DiffLUT-Net` (`arXiv:2609.09254`, `-52%` LUT6s vs. DWN) / BDD Boolean minimization, the agent as compiler rather than deployed runtime, and universal `4,096 B` (`CompactLut6Page`) portability from `$4` `RP2040` SRAM and `Alif Ensemble E3/E4` `5.5 MB` MRAM/DTCM up to `Numato Aller A7` `XC7A200T` M.2 and `KV260`/`ZCU102` FPGAs.
  - *Walsh-Hadamard Harmonics & 2-Bit Wobble Degeneracy*: By the Linial–Mansour–Nisan (`LMN`) theorem, bounded-depth circuits concentrate energy in low-degree harmonics; naive 1-hot point memorization leaks `7/64` (`448 / 4096`) into brittle degree-`>=5` parity noise, whereas biological 2-bit wobble (`0xF << (target & 0x3C)`) drives degree-`>=5` noise to exact `0` while absorbing 2-bit sensor/paraphrase jitter.
  - *3-Part Bootstrap Nucleus (`16 KB` static `#![no_std]` Rust 1.100.0 `lut6-core`)*: `#1 SEED_KNOWLEDGE` (`4 KB` root + `4 KB` overlay), `#2 SEED_AGENCY` (`64-bit AgencyStateWord -> OperonFrame` across `0b00` Reflex/Sleep, `0b01` Endogenous Splicing, `0b10` Exogenous Tool I/O, and `0b11` Transcription & `APOPTOSIS_ROLLBACK`), and `#3 Monotonic Self-Refinement` (dual Walsh-harmonic + seed-anchor non-regression gate).
- **4-Camp Hybrid Compute Thesis & Dual-Reality Means Test**: Reconfigurable fabric + `lut6-core` unifies `(1) More Weights`, `(2) Better Algorithms / World Models`, `(3) Addition vs. Multiplication`, and `(4) Lookup Tables vs. Compute` (`DiffLUT-Net`, `PALUTE`, `EntroMCU`), governed by a 4-part Thermodynamic Means Test (`δ = 1.0`, `N_expected > (E_compile + E_write)/(E_escalate - E_LUT6)`, `F < τ_F`, conformal wake-gate & `h_min` kill floor) and a Dual-Reality Evaluation Protocol (*World As It Is* vs. *World As We Want It*).
